bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the proportion of unbiased, correct answer selections across 12 topics in Korean cultural contexts using the KoBBQ dataset under both ambiguous and disambiguated context conditions.

Measuring the accuracy of the model in predicting predefined ground-truth answers across bias, hate, illegal risk, and sensitiveness categories using the Large Language Model Trustworthiness Benchmark.
Qualitative assessment using scenario-based evaluation prompts based on an AI risk taxonomy to determine if the model generates harmful content or responds inappropriately in socio-economic contexts.
